flags.reason: misreads-source: The configuration section says "Every field has a label." Marking the Label part alwaysPresent=false contradicts this. /configuration/0 makes the same point as "Give every field a label."

misreads-source: The In context section shows only "Transfer money | From | Select an account | To | Continue". Nothing in the guide says the screen uses a Card, that From and To share "the same four accounts", or that the To error reads "Choose an account to transfer to". The description presents these as the guide's own example.

notes: /placementAdvice/3 adds "as a layer over the page". The cited anatomy sentence does not say this, but the sources section does ("in code the list opens as a layer over the page"), so it was not flagged. In /examples/0 errorMessage is set without isInvalid. That is consistent with the pre-continue state, but a human may want the example to show both states or to explain this.
